# Vendored frontend dependencies

Pinned release files copied from the upstream npm distributions through jsDelivr.
They are served locally: core application rendering does not rely on third-party
CDN availability. No third-party application/template repository was copied.
SafeOrbit's auth, workspace, and overview designs are original.

| Component | Version | Upstream | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bootstrap | 5.3.3 | https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap | MIT (`bootstrap.LICENSE`) |
| Chart.js | 4.4.8 | https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js | MIT (`chart.LICENSE`) |
| FullCalendar | 6.1.15 | https://github.com/fullcalendar/fullcalendar | MIT (`fullcalendar.LICENSE`) |
| SweetAlert2 | 11.17.2 | https://github.com/sweetalert2/sweetalert2 | MIT (`sweetalert2.LICENSE`) |
| Font Awesome Free | 6.7.2 | https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome | CSS MIT; fonts SIL OFL 1.1; icons CC BY 4.0 (`fontawesome/LICENSE.txt`) |

Versioned files and their license notices must be retained together. Third-party
minified source may reference optional source maps that are not shipped.
